column3: “the house of slavery” renders “a house of slaves.”
Close to the Hebrew; “before Me” renders “upon (before) my face.”
“who stays with you” renders “who is in your gates.”
“perceived” renders “were seeing,” and “the trumpet” renders “the shofar,” the ram’s horn.
“may remain with you” renders “may be on your faces.”
NASB supplies “other” and renders “with Me” as “besides Me.”
